home_tagline_body: A portfolio management lab with real Indonesian stock prices.
app_simulation_notice: Simulation. No real money and no real trades.
language_unknown_error: The form sent "{value}" in the field "{field}", but Portolab is only available in {languages}. Choose one of them in the language switch.
language_page_body: Choose a language with the switch at the top of the page.
language_rejected_title: The language could not be changed
language_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field "{field}" instead of text. Choose {languages} in the language switch.
language_missing_error: The form sent no language in the field "{field}". Choose {languages} in the language switch.
app_not_found_body: This address does not exist in Portolab. Check the address again, or go back to the home page.
app_unexpected_error_body: Portolab could not show this page. Try reloading the page. If the problem continues, tell your lecturer.
market_data_delay_notice: Prices are delayed by about {minutes} minutes and come from {source}. The latest price was recorded at {time} WIB.
market_data_empty_body: Portolab is fetching its first prices now. Reload this page in a moment to see them.
market_data_update_failed_notice: Portolab could not update the prices at {time} WIB, so the prices below are the last ones it stored.
market_data_empty_failed_body: Portolab has no prices yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_one_stale_price_notice: Portolab could not update the price of {codes} at {time} WIB, so the {codes} price below is the last one it stored.
market_data_several_stale_prices_notice: Portolab could not update the prices of {codes} at {time} WIB, so their prices below are the last ones it stored.
market_data_one_missing_price_notice: Portolab has no price for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch it at {time} WIB failed.
market_data_several_missing_prices_notic: Portolab has no prices for {codes} yet, because its latest attempt to fetch them at {time} WIB failed.
trading_missing_rules_error: Portolab cannot take this order yet, because it has not recorded the IDX rules for the trading day of the order. Tell your lecturer, so that the rules can be added.
trading_no_price_error: Portolab has no price for {code} yet, so it cannot check the order. Try again once Portolab shows a price for {code}.
trading_outside_universe_error: {code} is not in the LQ45 on {date}, and Portolab lets you buy only the stocks of the LQ45 of the trading day. Choose a stock that is in the LQ45 on that day.
trading_too_few_returns_error: {code} has {returns}, but Portolab computes the measures of a portfolio only when each of its stocks has {minimum}. You can buy {code} after the first trading day of {month} closes, when it has enough.
trading_too_many_lots_error: IDX accepts at most {maximum} in one order, but this order has {lots}. Split it into orders of at most {maximum} each.
trading_outside_limits_error: IDX rejects a price of {price} for {code} on {date} by its auto rejection limits, which allow a price at most {upper} above and {lower} below the reference price of {reference}, the close of the previous trading day. Choose a price from {lowest} to {highest}.
trading_off_tick_error: IDX accepts prices from {from} to below {to} only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range, so {price} is not a valid price. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_off_tick_top_error: IDX accepts prices of {from} and above only in steps of {tick}, the tick size of that range, so {price} is not a valid price. Choose {below} or {above}, the nearest valid prices.
trading_purchase_cost_error: Buying {lots} of {code} at {price} costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash is {available}.
trading_set_aside_cash_error: Your open buy orders set aside {setAside} of your cash of {cash} until they fill or expire.
trading_largest_purchase_error: The largest order that your available cash pays for at {price} is {lots}.
trading_no_affordable_lot_error: Your available cash does not pay for 1 lot at {price}.
trading_price_rose_error: Portolab did not fill your market order to buy {lots} of {code}, because the price rose from {checkedPrice} to {price} while the order waited. At {price} the order costs {cost}, which is {value} for the shares and {fee} for the broker fee, but your available cash was {available}.
trading_sale_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, and you hold {held}.
trading_no_shares_error: This order sells {lots} of {code}, but you hold no shares of {code}, and you can sell only shares that you hold. Check the stock, and whether you meant to buy it.
trading_set_aside_shares_error: Your open sell orders set aside {setAside} of them until they fill or expire.
trading_no_free_shares_error: You can sell more shares of {code} once one of those orders expires, or after you buy more of them.
trading_no_price_history_error: Portolab has not stored a complete month of the price history of {instrument} yet, so it cannot count whether {code} has the monthly returns that the measures need. Try again once Portolab has stored it.
trading_no_reference_close_error: Portolab has not stored the close of {code} on {date} yet, and IDX sets the range of prices of a limit order from that close. Try again once Portolab has stored it, which it can do after the prices of that day are final at {time} WIB, or place a market order, which needs no limit.
trading_lots_not_whole_error: The field "{field}" holds "{value}", but the number of lots must be a whole number from 1, such as 5. Enter the number of lots of the order.
trading_sell_for_cash_error: Selling shares that you hold adds to your available cash of {available}.
trading_wait_for_cash_error: Your open buy orders return the {setAside} that they set aside to your available cash as they expire.
trading_lower_price_error: Choose a price lower than {price} or another stock.
trading_limit_at_checked_price_error: A limit order at {checkedPrice}, which fills only if the price falls back to it, is within your available cash.
app_empty_field_error: The field "{field}" is empty, but Portolab needs it. Fill it in.
app_not_text_error: The form sent a value of type {type} in the field "{field}" instead of text. Reload the page and fill in the form again.
app_too_long_error: The field "{field}" holds at most {maximum} characters, but it has {length}. Shorten it.
accounts_forgot_password_notice: Forgot your password? Ask the person who runs this Portolab server to reset it.
accounts_wrong_credentials_error: Portolab found no account with this username and password. Check both and try again. After {failures} wrong attempts within {minutes} minutes, Portolab blocks the username for a while, so that nobody can guess its password.
accounts_username_blocked_error: Portolab blocks passwords for "{username}" until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong passwords for it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess the password. Try again after that time.
accounts_address_blocked_error: Portolab blocks passwords from your network until {time} WIB, because it received {failures} wrong passwords from it within {minutes} minutes. The block stops anyone who tries to guess passwords. Try again after that time.
accounts_first_setup_body: Welcome to Portolab. Give your name, choose your own password, and agree to the privacy notice to finish your account.
accounts_new_password_body: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
accounts_lecturer_name_hint: Your students see this name on each class that you teach.
accounts_password_hint: At least {minimum} characters. A short sentence that only you know is long enough and easy to remember.
accounts_password_too_short_error: The field "{field}" needs at least {minimum} characters, but it has {length}. Each extra character makes a password much harder to guess, so choose a longer one, such as a short sentence.
accounts_passwords_differ_error: The field "{field}" differs from the new password. Type the same password in both fields.
accounts_consent_label: I agree to the privacy notice
accounts_consent_missing_error: Portolab stores your data only with your agreement. Read the privacy notice, then tick "{field}".
accounts_consented_notice: You agreed to the privacy notice on {time} WIB.
accounts_password_changed_notice: Portolab saved your new password and signed you out on every other device.
accounts_wrong_current_password_error: The password in the field "{field}" is wrong. Type it again. After {failures} wrong attempts within {minutes} minutes, Portolab blocks your username for a while, so that nobody can guess its password.
accounts_refused_form_body: The form came from another site, or the browser did not say where it came from. Portolab refuses such a form, so that no other site can act in your name. Open Portolab directly and send the form again.
accounts_privacy_intro_body: Portolab is a simulation of portfolio management for classes. It stores only what a class needs, and it asks for your agreement before you start to use it.
accounts_privacy_username_body: Your username, which you sign in with.
accounts_privacy_name_body: Your name, so that the lecturer of a class knows whose work it sees, and so that students know who teaches their class.
accounts_privacy_password_body: Your password, only as a hash that cannot be turned back into the password.
accounts_privacy_classes_body: The classes that you teach or joined, and your simulated work in them, such as your orders and your portfolio.
accounts_privacy_consent_body: The time when you agreed to this notice.
accounts_privacy_session_body: For each device where you are signed in, a cookie that keeps you signed in. Portolab stores only a hash of it, and the session ends after {days} days without a visit.
accounts_privacy_address_body: The address of your network, in memory only, for {minutes} minutes after each wrong password from it, to stop anyone from guessing passwords.
accounts_privacy_language_body: A cookie with the language that you chose, which stays in your browser.
accounts_privacy_not_stored_body: Portolab stores no email address, no phone number, and nothing about your real finances. It uses no tracking and no advertising, and it gives your data to no one.
accounts_privacy_lecturer_body: The lecturer of a class sees the name, the username, and the work of each student in it. Students do not see the data of other students.
accounts_privacy_server_body: The person who runs this Portolab server can read everything that it stores, because they keep its database.
accounts_privacy_rights_body: Indonesia's Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection gives you the right to see, correct, and delete your data, and to withdraw your agreement. Portolab keeps your data until the person who runs this server deletes it, so ask them for any of these.
accounts_sign_out_body: Sign out of Portolab on this device.
accounts_privacy_attempts_body: A username that someone typed with a wrong password, in memory only, for {minutes} minutes after each wrong password for it, to stop anyone from guessing the password of an account.
